summary: map.json is centred on the LLM route proposer/critic (routeProposal.ts). The deterministic quantitative planner that actually produces the owner's adopted plan (composeGoalModel -> evaluateGoalPortfolio -> judgeAcceptance -> reconstructionFor/exploreDirections/sweepVariables -> adoptReconstruction -> judgeFeasibility -> committee -> gateIntegrity -> planSteps -> continuationOf) is almost untested: 0 questions mention reconstruction, portfolio, simulation, sweep, exploration, integrity, continuation, signatures, lenses, specialists, reconsider, sprint or degraded.

gaps.capability: Constructed arrangement generation and candidate selection (the non-LLM generator)
gaps.question: For 10 goals, of the arrangements constructArrangements/graphPass enumerate, how many reach selectCandidates' window, and does the HELD/EVIDENCED/RANKED slotting admit a candidate whose only weakness is no prior evidence (cold-start)?
gaps.why: goalArrangements feeds composeGoalModel; the arrangement set is the main supply of openings the planner and reconstruction can adopt. HELD slots keep last readings' leaders, so a bad early leader can lock out alternatives.
gaps.observable: Same leaders across consecutive readings with no new evidence; alternatives never enter the window; plan set shows <3 distinct legs while construction reports hundreds of candidates.

gaps.question: Do arrangementSignature/canonicalSignature collapse genuinely different arrangements (or keep near-identical ones) because signatures are built from tokenized claim text?
gaps.why: Diversity of the plan set is decided here, not by the critic (C08 tests only the LLM). Diagnosis doc: 426 candidates -> 49 distinct, signatures like 'risk=are client marketplace one pay...'.
gaps.observable: Hand-label 50 pairs collapsed/kept; measure false-merge and false-split rates; plan set dimensions (planSet.differingDimensions) show duplicates.

gaps.capability: Arrangement pre-screen in the quantitative model (deadline, capital, hours, loss per deal)
gaps.question: Does screenArrangement/losesMoneyPerDeal/selectEstimatedArrangements cut arrangements for the right reason (settles after deadline, capital beyond limit, hours beyond owner's, every deal losing money), and are false cuts recoverable?
gaps.why: C09 tests parseRoutes only; this is the hard-limit filter for the openings the plan is actually built from. A wrong cut silently removes the winning structure.
gaps.observable: Cut-reason histogram per goal; replay cut arrangements with corrected facts and see if any would have been adopted.

gaps.capability: Opening economic model (price, volume, close, days-to-cash, owner hours, supply cost)
gaps.question: For 20 openings, do modelOpportunity's inferred price/close/volume/daysToCash and ownerHoursOf/reconstructedSupplyCostPerDeal match a hand computation from the cited evidence, and does priceContradiction fire when evidence conflicts?
gaps.why: C25/C26 test the LLM's arithmetic in parseRoutes; the plan's reach, p10 and steps come from this model instead.
gaps.observable: Diff of modelled vs hand-computed inputs; openings whose daysToCash falls outside the window yet are counted toward reach.

gaps.capability: Portfolio simulation and the conservative settled figure
gaps.question: Does evaluateGoalPortfolio (demandWorlds, sampler, settlementOf, stakeCycles) plus conservative() and the without* lot filters produce a p10/p50 a human would derive, with capital tied up as peak (peakConcurrentLots) not sum and net targets net of cost?
gaps.code: server/services/goals/portfolio.ts:evaluateGoalPortfolio (1315), demandWorlds (873); server/services/goals/plan.ts:conservative (1446), withoutSpareOwnerWork (1309), withoutLossMakingLots (1358), withoutSpareCapitalLots (1385), withoutUnestablishedLots (1418), peakConcurrentLots (1240)
gaps.why: Acceptance (the 90% defensible reach, §95) is read from this distribution; an error here flips ACCEPTED/CANDIDATE_ONLY regardless of route quality.
gaps.observable: Hand-built 3-opening portfolios with known answers; compare p10/p50, capital held and owner hours; check net vs gross targets.

gaps.capability: Validation ladder / link checks per opening
gaps.question: Does linkChecks/validationStage assign each opening the right missing link (demand, conversion, economics, settles, fulfilment, volume) and does nextTestFor name the cheapest test that would close it?
gaps.code: server/services/goals/plan.ts:linkChecks (961), validationStage (872), currentDemandCheck (920), economicsState (1051), settlesState (1072), fulfilmentCheck (1093), volumeCheck (1116), nextTestFor (1185)
gaps.why: Decides which openings are 'considered' vs held for research, and what the next test is; C35 tests readiness only at the judgeAcceptance level.
gaps.observable: Ladder counts (ladderOf) per goal vs hand labels; openings stuck at the same stage across readings.

gaps.question: Does judgeAcceptance's 90% condition use measuredPlanChance/planCalibration correctly, and is a candidate's coverage ever reported as a probability (§60)?
gaps.why: The single readiness verdict the owner sees. Map C35-P only notes it is 'unattainable by research'; it does not test the decision logic or calibration.
gaps.observable: Construct readings at 89%/91% p10 reach, with and without measured calibration rows; check status and sentence.

gaps.capability: Plan reconstruction when short of requirement (§99)
gaps.question: When acceptance is not ACCEPTED, does reconstructPlan (partitionOpenings, gatesOf, buildOperators, wilsonLower) find structural changes (price, volume, prepayment, fulfilment) that a human strategist would, and are its fulfilmentQuestions/volumeQuestionsFor turned into research?
gaps.why: This is Brain's main 'revise the plan' mechanism and produces the adopted candidate in most short goals; the map's C32 tests only the LLM replacement ask.
gaps.observable: Reconstruction moves per goal, share that are measured vs assumed (Reconstruction.established), and whether their questions appear in the research queue.

gaps.question: Does exploreDirections (seedDirections, stanceQuotas, mutate, recombine, challengeProgram, scoreOf, diverseLeaders) converge on better and diverse structures than the baseline in its time budget, or return the seed when evaluations time out?
gaps.code: server/services/goals/reasoning/directions.ts:exploreDirections (899), stanceQuotas (752), mutate (834), recombine (817), challengeProgram (622), scoreOf (891), diverseLeaders (1136)
gaps.why: §101/§102 search over plan variants; its leader becomes the reconstruction's best. Not referenced by any question.
gaps.observable: Lift of leader over baseline per goal, number of generations run before DEFAULT_MAX_MS, leader diversity (distance) and challenged vs bare score gap.

gaps.question: Does discoverVariables/discoverConditions find the binding variables (price, volume, close, capital) and does narrowLevels + topInteractions identify the effect that matters, within MIN_EFFECT/REQUIREMENT_BOUND?
gaps.why: Supplies the 'which lever moves reach' reading and price variables used by candidateStrategyReading; the binding factor shown to the owner comes from here.
gaps.observable: Synthetic portfolio with a known binding variable; check the sweep names it; 'three binding diagnoses in one reading' (diagnosis doc) is a symptom.

gaps.question: When inventDue, do inventDirections' model calls produce parseable, in-scope designs (parseInvented/composeInventedDesigns), and how many are refused vs adopted?
gaps.why: A second LLM generator feeding the reconstruction, separate from the route proposer; C23 covers model failures only for route asks.
gaps.observable: Per-run {calls, proposed, refused, error, rejections}; share of adopted reconstructions containing an invented design.

gaps.capability: Cross-goal reasoning-method learning (UCB library, stance prior)
gaps.question: Does recordExploration write the lift of each method/stance, and do loadLibrary (ucb) and loadStancePrior actually shift the next goal's seeds toward methods that worked?
gaps.why: This is the only learning loop actually read back on the planning path; C37 tests only route 'rethink' lessons (which have no reader).
gaps.observable: methodYield rows over time; seed allocation by stance before/after a run of wins; a stance with zero lift still receiving its full quota.

gaps.question: When the worker-thread evaluator times out or a thread dies (EVALUATION_TIMEOUT_MS, REPLACEMENTS_PER_WINDOW), is the reconstruction marked degraded rather than silently returning a shallow search?
gaps.why: All exploration/sweep quality depends on enough evaluations completing; C39 does not cover the evaluator.
gaps.observable: degraded[] entries on readings; evaluations completed vs requested (defaultEvaluations) per reading.

gaps.capability: Adopting one plan (reconstruction vs plan as held)
gaps.question: Does adoptReconstruction adopt the reconstruction exactly when it is inside limits, not implausible and materially better on established (not assumed) moves, and is a hypothetical reconstruction never presented as the plan?
gaps.why: The actual 'compare and select one strategy' step for the owner's plan. Map C33 points at applyCritique, which only ranks LLM routes.
gaps.observable: Readings where the steps' leg differs from the candidate's leg, or 'four best strategies in one reading' (diagnosis doc).

gaps.capability: Infeasibility by arithmetic and held-market ceilings
gaps.question: Does judgeFeasibility/judgeHeldMarkets conclude NOT_VIABLE only when arithmetic (every estimate at its favourable end) cannot reach the requirement, never on a short pool, and does relaxAlso name the relaxation that would make it feasible?
gaps.code: server/services/goals/plan.ts:judgeFeasibility (3743), judgeHeldMarkets (3889), heldCeiling (3845), agreedInReach (3809), everyCaseInfeasible (1518), relaxAlso (3960), notSupported (3967)
gaps.why: A false NOT_VIABLE ends planning for the goal; a missed one keeps spending research on an impossible goal. Unmapped.
gaps.observable: Goals with NOT_VIABLE whose later openings reached the target; goals the owner would call impossible still NEEDS_EVIDENCE after many rounds.

gaps.capability: Investment committee rule roles and answer settlement (§117)
gaps.question: Do the six COMMITTEE_ROLES (reviewRole/reviewPlan) block plans on correct grounds, does evidencedReach recompute reach from legs, and does settleByAnswers settle a question when research answers it?
gaps.why: The committee can refuse an ACCEPTED plan; the map only checks whether its questions are answered (C22-R), not whether its verdicts are right.
gaps.observable: Blocks per role vs hand review on 10 readings; false blocks; questions settled vs answers on record.

gaps.question: When specialists are configured, do reviewWithSpecialists/parseSpecialist return usable independent findings, and does armSpecialistReview bind them into the next reading (state != NOT_RUN)?
gaps.why: The only independent model critic of the whole plan (as opposed to single routes); production reads NOT_RUN.
gaps.observable: specialists.state on readings; parse failures; agreement rate with rule roles (agreement is not evidence, §117).

gaps.question: Does gateIntegrity/integrityInput refuse every ACCEPTED reading that breaks a rule (lead price, membership, window), and only those?
gaps.why: Last filter before RECOMMENDABLE; a false pass shows the owner an invalid plan, a false refusal hides a valid one.
gaps.observable: Seeded readings with one violation each; integrity.violations vs expected.

gaps.capability: Step-writing guards (window, figures, missing transaction stages, owner of each step)
gaps.question: Do collectsOutsideWindow, withholdImplausibleFigures, missingTransactionStages and ownerOf (BRAIN vs PERSON) catch steps that collect after the window, print implausible figures, skip a transaction stage, or hand Brain's work to the owner?
gaps.code: server/services/goals/plan.ts:planSteps (4207), collectsOutsideWindow (4654), withholdImplausibleFigures (4615), missingTransactionStages (4584), ownerOf (4052), killFor (4088); server/services/goals/arrangementSteps.ts
gaps.why: C36 asks whether steps exist; these guards decide whether they are executable and correctly owned.
gaps.observable: stepsMissing non-empty on RECOMMENDABLE readings; steps assigned PERSON that Brain operations could do; kill criteria absent.

gaps.question: Does buildPlanSet produce plans that differ on DISTINCTNESS_DIMENSIONS, and does rebuildAfter/resilienceOf correctly say which plan survives a change (e.g. a leg refuted)?
gaps.why: The owner-facing alternatives and fallback; C08-R tests distinctness only through the critic.
gaps.observable: Plan sets with 2+ plans differing on 0 dimensions; rebuildAfter verdicts vs recomputed plans after a refutation.

gaps.question: Does planInputsFingerprint change when any input a reading depends on changes (new claim, owner term change, dive answer), so planDue re-reads, and stay stable otherwise?
gaps.why: C38 tests route re-asks (routeAskDue); the plan itself only adapts if this fires.
gaps.observable: Readings whose inputs changed but whose fingerprint did not (stale plan); excessive re-reads with identical inputs.

gaps.capability: Reconsideration of decisions when underlying facts change
gaps.question: When a fact a decision record rests on changes, do changedFacts/dependentsOf find the dependent goals/openings and does reconcileFactChanges re-open them?
gaps.why: The mechanism for C04-F/C38-I ('stale openings retired', 'new evidence changes plan'), but no question names it.
gaps.observable: Change a price fact under a held opening; check a RECONSIDER event and a new reading within one pass.

gaps.question: Does reconcileCalibration compare goal predictions with outcomes, classify misses (classifyMiss) and produce methodCorrections that the planner reads?
gaps.why: §108 'a decision is judged by what it predicted'; with no reader, Brain cannot learn its planning bias. Map C37-P mentions calibration lessons only as recorded.
gaps.observable: Calibration pass reports per goal; whether any correction changes a later reading's inputs.

gaps.question: Do notWorthResearching and tooSmallForGoals/recordMateriality skip research that cannot change a decision (too small a share, closes before a dive can finish) without excluding the opening that would decide the goal?
gaps.why: This is the real implementation of C12's 'stop when research cannot change the decision'; untested.
gaps.observable: Openings marked not-worth/too-small that later proved decisive; dives skipped by closing runway.

gaps.question: Do compareDiveValue/diveOrder/fieldsWorthResearching and startValidations start dives on the openings and fields with the highest decision value for live goals, and do capacity deferrals (recordCapacityDeferrals) push out the right ones?
gaps.why: Dives establish buyer/price/demand the plan is judged on; the map tests dives only as a destination (C07-R, C10-R).
gaps.observable: Dive starts ranked vs the planner's researchPriority/planResearchPriority; pending dives blocking the next test for days.

gaps.question: Do researchPriority/planResearchPriority/heldForResearch/diagnoseGoalResearch name the research that would most move reach, and does that ordering reach the research queue (decideResearchAllocation)?
gaps.why: C35-I asks only whether not-ready names research; this tests the planner's priorities actually steer research capacity.
gaps.observable: Rank correlation between planner priority and queue order/started fragments; DECISION_VALUE_WEIGHT effect.

notReal: C41 (R/I/F): 'Fitness changes routing', 'better model used when measured better', 'failing model benched' have no implementation for route/planning asks. strongRouteModels (routeProposal.ts:1419) is selected by env (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY + BRAIN_ROUTE_MODEL), not by measurement; operationsReport's stronger-model call reads Hermes tool success. Measured ranking exists only for the operator's own models (operator/run.ts:97 rankOperatorModels), not for proposer/critic/invent/specialists.

C17-P component 'tools/verify.py (eval)': no tools/ directory exists in the repo; quote re-verification against a re-read page is an eval-side check, not a production faculty. The gate (research/gate.ts) does not re-open pages.

C33-P component 'applyCritique': selection of the owner's plan is done by judgeAcceptance + adoptReconstruction + planSet (plan.ts:1648, 3630; planSet.ts:649); applyCritique only ranks LLM routes inside one ask, so C33 tests a selector the plan does not use.

C12 ('stop when research cannot change the decision'): the value-of-information module cash/infoValue.ts:planQuestions has no caller; the only live stopping logic is materiality/notWorthResearching, which the map does not name.

C02-R/C02-F: there is no persisted owner profile to correct; ownerProfileOf output is kept only in event detail and re-derived each ask, so 'profile corrected' tests a mechanism that does not exist (a valid gap finding, but not a capability with code).

C37 as framed (route 'rethink' lessons read by the next ask): routeContext reads no learnings; the real cross-goal learning loop on the planning path is goals/reasoning/learning.ts (UCB library, stance prior), which the map omits.
goals/commercialReality.ts:planCommercialReality has no caller (only commercialRealityOf is used, from pathways.ts) - any capability phrased as a plan-level commercial-reality verdict is dead code.
